newsitem.title: USA: NeoPharm Q4 hurt by higher R&D expenses.
newsitem.headline: NeoPharm Q4 hurt by higher R&D expenses.

text.p: NeoPharm Inc, a development-stage bio-pharmaceutical company, said the increased loss in its 1996 fourth quarter was due to higher research and development and administrative expenses.
The R&D costs were related to the December filing of a new drug application, an in-vivo cell proliferation market used as a prognostic in breast cancer.
The company also is developing liposome-encapsulated chemotherapeutic agents targeted at patients who have become resistant to cancer drug therapy.
NeoPharm posted a fourth quarter loss of $0.11 per share compared to a year-ago quarterly loss of $0.08. For the full year, it reported a loss of $0.24 compared to a 1995 loss of $0.36 per share.
